card.name: Dose units right after a number
card.fires_on: The last piece of a dose unit or amount right after a number, such as the g in mcg or μg, the ers in microliters, or the word million before PFU. It also fires on the decimal point or space inside a number.

modes.label: Microgram and microliter endings
modes.description: Final piece of micro-units spelled out or abbreviated after a dose number.
modes.example: coadministration of inhaled salmeterol (50 mc<<g>> twice daily) and oral ketoconazole

modes.label: Large count words and number punctuation
modes.description: The word million or the point or space inside a number in a dose or concentration.
modes.example: 4 mL 10 8 (100<< million>>) PFU per mL Inject any new

card.writes: It seems to push toward concentration, amount and dosage words, mostly Chinese ones, and away from unrelated name pieces.
card.plain: It lights up on the end of a dose unit like mcg or microliters right after a number.
